content.text:
Implemented in `/Users/jamie/development/exposed-http-tracing`, branch `codex/http-tracing-once`. Exclusive ownership returned; no active background processes, commit, or PR.

Accepted deviations implemented:

- Single private Axum middleware replaces tower-http, preserving request context even when spans are filtered.
- Opaque `SubscriberInitializationError` distinguishes stderr fallback without subscriber detection.
- Direct error/warn macros are prohibited by Clippy; CI checks generic event macros outside the two owner files. Function-level Clippy allowances proved ineffective and were removed.
- Internal failures log retained source diagnostics; request metadata excludes raw paths, queries, headers, and bodies. HTTP 500 responses remain generic.

Verification passed:

- `cargo test -p exposed --lib inbound::http::tracing`: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p exposed --test http_tracing_process`: 3 passed.
- `cargo test -p exposed --test integration healthz_returns_empty_no_content`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo clippy --locked --workspace --lib --bins -- -D warnings`
- Formatting and diff checks.
- Temporary prohibited `tracing::error!` and generic-event probes both rejected, then removed.
- Live healthcheck subprocess succeeded silently despite invalid `RUST_LOG` and absent `DATABASE_URL`.

Tests cover severity/counts, retained diagnostics, unchanged error bodies, extractor/fallback/method failures, request privacy, concurrent span isolation, and failed health under literal `error` filtering.
